title: CSCI 590 — Undergraduate Thesis
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a thesis document, including hypothesis formulation, literature review, methodology, results reporting, and conclusion.
Apply responsible technical communication principles by distinguishing claims from evidence and accurately reporting limitations.
Evaluate ethical and professional standards for research integrity, including confidentiality, fairness, and conflict disclosure.
